```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Chunks call the live Iconify API, so they only run when asked to
# (the pkgdown workflow sets this variable).
live <- identical(Sys.getenv("ICONIFYR_LIVE_VIGNETTES"), "true")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = live)
library(iconifyr)
```

iconifyr wraps the [Iconify API](https://iconify.design/docs/api/). Icons are
identified as `prefix:name`, for example `mdi:home`.

## Fetch an icon

```{r get}
svg <- iconify_get("mdi:home", color = "#ba3329", size = 48)
cat(svg)
```

`color`, `size` (height in pixels), `flip` and `rotate` map to the API's query
parameters.

## Find icons

```{r search}
hits <- iconify_search("home", prefixes = c("mdi", "tabler"), limit = 40)
head(hits)
```

```{r sets}
sets <- iconify_sets()
head(sets[order(-sets$total), ], 5)
length(iconify_icons("tabler"))
```

## Inline icons in R Markdown and Quarto

`iconify_html()` returns raw HTML, so it works in inline code. For example,
`` `r knitr::inline_expr('iconifyr::iconify_html("mdi:github", size = 16)')` ``
renders as `r if (live) iconifyr::iconify_html("mdi:github", size = 16)`.

In a chunk, use `results = "asis"`:

````markdown
`r ''````{r, results = "asis"}
iconifyr::iconify_html("mdi:home", color = "steelblue", size = 32)
```
````

The same function works in Shiny UI code, e.g. `tags$button(iconify_html("mdi:refresh"), "Reload")`.

## Icons in a gt table

```{r gt, eval = live && requireNamespace("gt", quietly = TRUE)}
ids <- c("mdi:home", "mdi:account", "mdi:cog")
tbl <- data.frame(
  id = ids,
  icon = vapply(ids, function(x) as.character(iconify_get(x, size = 20)), ""),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
gt::gt(tbl) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = "icon")
```

## Icons in a ggplot

`iconify_png()` renders through rsvg. To place an icon on a plot, rasterize the
SVG and add it as an annotation.

```{r ggplot, eval = live && requireNamespace("rsvg", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE), fig.width = 4, fig.height = 3}
svg <- iconify_get("mdi:star", color = "#e0a800", size = 128)
img <- rsvg::rsvg_nativeraster(charToRaw(svg), width = 128)
grob <- grid::rasterGrob(img, interpolate = TRUE)

ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(2, 3, 5)), ggplot2::aes(x, y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::annotation_custom(grob, xmin = 1, xmax = 1.5, ymin = 4, ymax = 5) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

## Save icons

```{r download}
paths <- iconify_download(c("mdi:home", "tabler:star"), dir = tempdir())
basename(paths)
```

## Caching, retries and self-hosting

- Responses are cached under `tools::R_user_dir("iconifyr", "cache")`. Turn
  this off with `options(iconifyr.cache = FALSE)`; wipe it with
  `iconify_cache_clear()`.
- Requests retry up to 3 times on HTTP 429 and 5xx.
- Point the package at a self-hosted API with
  `options(iconifyr.api = "https://icons.example.org")`.
